questions.question_english: The Nutrient enrichment of water causes the natural aging of the lake. This is called?
questions.question_hindi: पानी के पोषक तत्व संवर्धन झील की प्राकृतिक उम्र बढ़ने का कारण बनता है। यह कहा जाता है?
questions.explanation_english: Eutrophication occurs when water bodies, like lakes, receive excessive nutrients, often from human activities. These nutrients lead to increased plant and algae growth, disrupting the ecosystem balance. As these organisms die and decompose, oxygen levels decline, harming aquatic life. Nutrient enrichment accelerates the aging process of the lake, resulting in eutrophication.
